title: Kamloops Lake through the summer
question: How did the east end of Kamloops Lake change between 19 June and 17 October 2026, and does the river gauge agree?
summary: Between 19 June and 17 October 2026, 0.22–0.92 km² brightened (HH) and 0.16–1.01 km² darkened (HH) in the 84 km² area. The Thompson River gauge (8.4 km away) dropped from 5.44 m to 2.47 m.

title: The June 2026 earthquakes in Venezuela
question: Did the ground move here during the earthquakes of 24 June 2026, and by how much?
summary: The ground moved up to 48 to 66 cm along the radar line of sight between 17 and 29 June 2026, with 422.0 to 845.2 km² showing movement exceeding 2x the noise level (5.0 cm). This coincides with two major earthquakes (7.5 and 7.2 magnitude) on 24 June 2026, located within 150 km of the area.

title: A Florida river floodplain in October
question: How did this river floodplain change between 27 September and 21 October 2026, and do the river gauges agree?
summary: Between 27 September and 21 October 2026, the Choctawhatchee River floodplain showed radar brightness increases over 0.05 to 32.37 km² (HH polarization) and decreases over 0.0 to 0.5 km². River gauge 02366500 recorded 1.494 m on 2026-09-27 and 3.313 m on 2026-10-21. River gauge 02365769 recorded 2.871 m on 2026-09-27 and 3.560 m on 2026-10-21.
